main_text.p: universæ philosophiæ. Quod ipsum & ego planum feci superiori anno 1614. in dedicatione & præfatione methodi meæ theologicæ: vbi inter alia recepi, me, ad vmbilicum perductâ ista methodo, cocinnaturum Encyclopædiam Biblicam seu, quod idem est, Triumphum Bibliorum, adeoque philosophiæ, iurisprudentiæ & medicinæ sacræ, & sacrofanctæ theologiæ.

Hoc jam nunc Deo duce præsto, & ita præsto, vt, quidquid est rerum philosophicarum, iuridicarum, medicarum & theologicarum in diuinissimo Scripturæ canone, certâ methodo ad facultatum & disciplinarum capita & systemata, vel systematum partes, vel denique variorum systematum combinationes reuocem. Quod vt intelligi possit facilius, ita statuere oportet, disciplinam siue scienti-am,ho-

page.notes: Faint marks at the bottom left (near "inv" and "+ (·)") are show-through or stains and are not transcribed. The printed text in the scan is spelled with long s throughout; it is rendered here as plain s. The last line ends with a hyphen: "scienti-" and "am,ho-" run together across the line break as printed.
